data.one_liner: A TextFormField that emits DateTimes and helps show picker dialogs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text form field widget designed to handle date and time inputs. It integrates with standard Material and Cupertino picker dialogs using callback functions.
use_when: You need date and time input fields inside Flutter forms
You want to format date and time values inside a TextFormField
avoid_when: You are looking for calendar grid UI components rather than input fields
strengths: Simplifies date and time input within forms
Supports custom pickers and formatting via intl
weaknesses: Forked version needed for newer Flutter releases

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides enhanced calendar date picker widgets if you need a full calendar UI instead of a form text field.
